relationship_to_final_cold_v1: All numerical, algorithmic, model, training, and stopping settings are unchanged. Only the evaluation instance grid is expanded.

calibration.reason: No protocol adjustment is made. Existing verified parameters are retained to avoid result-dependent tuning.

analysis_frozen_before_results.timing: Report every exact/hybrid pair, per-instance speedup with sign, and median/range summaries by scenario count. Negative speedups remain visible.
analysis_frozen_before_results.accuracy: Require both ADMM residual tolerances for every exact/hybrid run. Report terminal residuals, absolute and relative gaps, and all solver diagnostics. Fixed-proxy ML runs remain uncertified.
analysis_frozen_before_results.statistics: Five paired instances per scenario count are descriptive evidence, not a confirmatory significance study. No selective seed exclusion.
analysis_frozen_before_results.failure_policy: A failed or nonconverged run remains in the manifest and is reported; it is not replaced by a more favorable seed.

scope_limit: S=100 is the largest added scenario count. No claim is made about S>100 or historical-data calibration.
